name: Nakanai Neko
source:
One day Naoki sees a dream that recovers forgotten memories. In the dream he kills his parents inspired by his sister-in-law.  
Naoki resonates with the girls who have "heart wounds". Will he be able to heal their and his own wounds?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一天，直树做了一个唤回遗忘记忆的梦。梦中，他受嫂子煽动杀害了父母。
直树与那些拥有「心灵创伤」的女孩产生共鸣。他能治愈她们的伤口，也治愈自己的伤口吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
